emptyFolder: This folder is empty. Drag a group onto it in the folder column.
emptyList: When you have several tabs open, click the savetab icon in your browser toolbar. Your open tabs will appear here.
dropNewGroup: Drop here to create a new group
shareFailed: The sync server could not be reached. The shared page did not change.
shareNotCopied: The page is shared, but the link was not copied. Use "Copy share link" in the menu.
menuRestoreIncognito: Restore in a new incognito window
incognitoNotAllowed: Allow savetab in private windows on the browser's extensions page
moveMixedKinds: Select only tabs, or only groups and folders, to move or copy them together.
confirmOpenTabs: You are about to open {n} tabs
confirmEmptyTrash: Permanently delete everything in the trash?
menuSendCurrent: Send only this tab to savetab
menuSendExcept: Send all tabs except this tab to savetab
menuSendLeft: Send tabs on the left to savetab
menuSendRight: Send tabs on the right to savetab
menuSendWindow: Send all tabs in this window to savetab
menuSendAllWindows: Send all tabs from all windows to savetab
menuSendTabGroup: Send all tabs in this tab group to savetab
menuSendLink: Send this web link to savetab
excludeSite: Exclude this web site from savetab
exportHint: This list can be imported into savetab or OneTab on this or another computer.
importHint: One link per line as {format}. A blank line starts a new group.
noLinksFound: No links found. Each line needs a URL with its protocol, such as https://example.com | Title
bookmarksHint: Each chosen bookmark folder becomes a savetab folder, with its bookmarks as one group.
toolbarActionLegend: When you click the savetab toolbar icon:
toolbarSendWindow: Send tabs in the current window (only the selected tabs, or the current tab group, if any)
toolbarSendWholeWindow: Send the current window, including all tabs and tab groups
toolbarSendCurrent: Send only the current tab (it joins the first group that is not pinned or locked)
pinnedSkip: Don't send pinned tabs (sending only this tab still works)
pinnedAllow: Allow pinned tabs to be sent
titleOnDuplicateLegend: When storing a tab that is already stored:
excludedLegend: Excluded web sites (tabs from these hosts are not sent, unless you send only that tab):
afterRestoreRemove: Remove them from your list (a middle click keeps them)
restoreGroupLegend: When restoring a group of tabs:
restoreNewUnlessAlone: Open the tabs in a new window, unless savetab is the only tab in the current window
restoreNew: Open the tabs in a new window
restoreCurrent: Open the tabs in the current window
restoreTabLegend: When restoring a tab from the list:
restoreTabSwitch: Open the tab and switch to it (a middle click stays here)
restoreTabStay: Open the tab and stay in savetab
groupTitleClickLegend: When you click on a group's title:
discardLegend: Background tabs when restoring a group:
discardOn: Discard tabs on open (each tab loads when you switch to it)
displaySwitch: Switch to the window where savetab is already open
displayMove: Move an open savetab tab to the current window
contextMenuOff: Disabled (the exclude-site item goes away too)
backupNone: No backup yet. savetab backs up your list every week.
restoredFromBackup: Your list was restored from the backup of {date}
firefoxShortcuts: Open about:addons, click the cog icon, then choose "Manage Extension Shortcuts".
placeholderMessage: Your browser does not let extensions open this address. Copy it into the address bar.
popupIncludeGrouped: Tabs in a browser tab group
popupCloseStored: Close tabs already stored in savetab
toolbarPopup: Show a popup to choose which tabs to send, and where
syncIntro: Your list is encrypted on this device before it goes to your server. The server cannot read it.
syncJoinIntro: This account already has a key. Enter the recovery key, or pair with a device that is signed in.
syncPairWaiting: On a signed-in device, open Sync and choose this device.
syncPairCompare: Check that the other device shows this code.
syncRecoveryShown: Write this recovery key down now. It is shown only once, and without it your synced list cannot be recovered.
syncStatusFailed: The last sync failed at {date}. savetab tries again every minute.
syncStatusSignedOut: The server signed this device out. Sign out here, then sign in again.
syncErrBadServerUrl: Enter the server address as a URL, such as https://sync.example.com.
syncErrWrongRecoveryKey: That recovery key does not open this account.
syncErrPairingExpired: The pairing expired. Start it again.
syncErrPairingMismatch: The other device sent a key that does not fit its pairing request. Pairing stopped.
syncErrServerFailed: The server did not answer as expected. Check the address and try again.
